homedir.description: Directory used for bsfilter home (databases, state files)

db.description: Database backend: sdbm, gdbm, bdb1, bdb, or qdbm

jtokenizer.description: Tokenizer for Japanese text: bigram, block, mecab, chasen, kakasi

spam_cutoff.description: Spam probability cutoff threshold (0.0–1.0); uses method-specific default if omitted

max_line.description: Maximum lines to process per message (0 = all lines)

auto_update.description: Enable automatic learning from filtered mail

refer_header.description: Additional headers to reference beyond defaults

mark_spam_subject.description: Prefix inserted at beginning of spam subject line

imap_settings.description: List of IMAP server configurations (use with --imap mode); each item may include: imap_server, imap_port, imap_auth, imap_user, imap_password, imap_folder_clean, imap_folder_spam, imap_fetch_unseen, imap_fetch_unflagged, imap_reset_seen_flag, ssl, ssl_cert

pop_settings.description: List of POP proxy configurations (use with --pop mode); each item may include: pop_server, pop_port, pop_proxy_port, pop_proxy_if, pop_user, pop_max_size, pid_file, ssl

max_mail.description: Threshold to reduce token database when mail count exceeds this

min_mail.description: Effective minimum mail count for database reduction

mbox.description: Use Unix 'from' separator for mbox format files
